svg.title: Current Research Pipeline Only
svg.desc: HD anonymized research-only diagram showing retrieval, synthesis, consensus, verification, scoring, graph construction, final package and deep analysis continuation.
svg.text: CURRENT RESEARCH PIPELINE ONLY
ANONYMIZED TECHNICAL FLOW / NO UI LAYER / NO API ROUTING LAYER / ACTIVE RESEARCH LOGIC
ACCURACY: ONE ACTIVE SEARCH ROUTE
ACCURACY: TWO ACTIVE AI ROUTES
SECONDARY CONSENSUS IS OPTIONAL
DEEP ANALYSIS CONTINUES AFTER BASE REPORT
01 RETRIEVAL FOUNDATION
query intake, client cache, active web retrieval, server quality filters, deduplication, ranking and compression
02 PRIMARY SYNTHESIS FOUNDATION
prompt assembly, primary model synthesis, JSON parsing, source grounding and trace preservation
03 TRUST + QUALITY LAYER
optional secondary model comparison, citation verification, score signals and graph payload generation
04 DEEP ANALYSIS CONTINUATION
the completed base report can branch into a deeper thesis pipeline with expanded retrieval and deep scores
05 FINAL STRUCTURED RESEARCH PACKAGE
the completed intelligence object used by rendering, export, sharing and long-term archive flows

Cache hit skips live retrieval but still feeds source context into synthesis.
Secondary consensus and citation verification fail gracefully when unavailable.
Deep analysis is a continuation branch, not a replacement for the base report.
